reviews.title: Clean install and plenty of power for upgrades
reviews.comment:
This power supply has been great so far. The fully modular design makes a big difference when you are trying to keep a PC build clean. You only have to use the cables you actually need, which helps a lot with cable management and airflow.

The 850W capacity gives plenty of room for a gaming setup and future upgrades. It feels well built, runs quiet, and I did not have any problems during installation. I also like that it is PCIe Gen 5 and ATX 3.0 ready, so it feels more future-proof than some older power supplies. Overall, it is a solid PSU and I would recommend it for a mid-to-high-end build.
